title: Open a site on launch day
purpose: Phones are counted, wearers screened, and pilots checked before the first real hour.
when: The day the dispatch schedule names.

steps.do: Count the kit with Mazen and sign.
steps.detail: Sign only for a whole kit.
steps.check: The count matches the dispatch schedule.

steps.do: Test the line where the phones will sit.
steps.detail: Below 100 Mbps sustained, it is a hub site.
steps.check: The site plan has the number and path.

steps.do: Post notices and mark the private rooms.
steps.detail: Restrooms, locker rooms, prayer rooms, clinics, private offices.
steps.check: They are in the site plan.

steps.do: Train the operators. Brief the wearers in Arabic.
steps.detail: Two hours on the test phone.
steps.check: Every wearer knows: tap stop before hat off.

steps.detail: ID showing 18 or older, Arabic consent, fraud sign-off, own account.

steps.do: Fit every rig and run one 30-minute pilot.
steps.check: Every screen shows the name in the wearer log.

steps.do: Check every pilot before any second cycle.
steps.detail: Angle, light, hands and work in frame.
steps.check: Every pilot passed and the reviewers watched.

steps.do: Get Moharam's yes, then set tomorrow.
steps.detail: Dock every phone. Clock-in 7:00 AM, first cycle 8:00 AM.
steps.check: Moharam said yes. Mano has the wrap report.

done: Moharam has certified the launch, and nothing records for real before that.

fails.if: The line tests below 100 Mbps sustained
fails.then: Pick the closest hub and name a runner today.

fails.if: Phones cannot leave the site overnight
fails.then: The site's wireless internet passes the test, or the phones go to a hub every night. Tell Moharam today.

fails.if: A wearer's papers are not complete
fails.then: They sit out until Mano confirms. Under 18 means no phone.

fails.if: A pilot fails on angle or lighting
fails.then: Refit the rig and record another 30 minutes.

fails.if: You are short of operators or gear
fails.then: Launch day moves. Call Moharam today for people or gear.

escalate: Moharam before you leave, Mano for files or the line, Youssef Medhat for pilots.
